perks.name: Full Court

notes: pandapaxxy (PvE / M+KB / Controller): Recommended MW: Blast Radius. Rapid-Fire Frame(150) Void Grenade Launcher Special Ammo. "There aren’t many places I see myself using a grenade launcher in PvE nowadays. Cascade Point is very fun and Full Court will net you some solid damage from afar, but I find myself using rockets over grenade launchers. Maybe for GMs or activities where ammo is a bit more scarce and using a rocket launcher wouldn’t be the best choice. Explosive Light really is carrying my weapons this season."
